judge_context: Use the package's existing encoder/decoder helpers in s2/encode.go (sticky-error writeUvarint/readUint32 etc.) and the typeTag mechanism in shape.go rather than encoding/gob or ad-hoc binary.Write calls. Per-shape encode/decode methods belong next to each shape type (lax_*.go, point_vector.go, loop.go), with ShapeIndex.Encode/Decode in a dedicated shapeindex_encode.go. Decoding must bound every length read from the stream before allocating, returning errors via the decoder's err field instead of panicking.

case_items.name: Existing encodings and Shape interface unchanged
case_items.name_zh: 既有编码格式与 Shape 接口不变
case_items.question: Does the change add ShapeIndex.Encode(io.Writer) error / Decode(io.Reader) error while keeping existing per-shape Encode/Decode wire formats, existing typeTag values and the exported Shape interface unchanged (new tags only for previously untagged types such as Loop/LaxLoop, below typeTagMinUser)?

criteria.perfect: Additive methods; existing wire formats byte-identical; new tags appended without renumbering.
criteria.accept: Additive API but an incidental change to an existing type (e.g. exported helper renamed) with no format impact.
criteria.bad: Existing encodings or typeTag numbering changed, or the exported Shape interface gains required methods.
